title: It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia- Season 5

reviews.author: Devadesát Dva
reviews.text: "Frank, can you get these kids outta here?" "Yeah. Come on. We're gonna go paint your room a color that's not stupid. Then we're gonna throw your toys in the trash!" (...) "I want my 35 cents back, Charlie, give him the pear." "I can't. I just ate it." "The whole thing?" "Yea, it was pretty gross." "The stem and then- and the core?" "You didn't tell me not to eat the stem, dude!" "Did you eat the stickers that are all over it?!" "YEAH IT WAS GROSS!" "OF COURSE IT's GROSS! IT's A STICKER, BRO!" "I EAT TICKERS ALL THE TIME, DUDE!" (...) "That's my character. I'm the TRASH MAN. I come out. I throw trash all over the ring. And then I start eating garbage." (...) "come on, ref. Is that even legal?" Ref Frank (who before was denied to appear as Trash Man): "I didn't see nothing." *walks away "I'M REAL AMERICAN, FIGHT FOR THE RIGHTS OF EVERY MAN, I'M THE REAL AMERICAN..." "I knew this shit wasn't fake." (Roddy Piper cameo, tohle byl celkem sweet díl pro všechny fans pro-wrestlingu) (...) "Cat in the wall, eh? Okay. Now you're talking my language. I know this game. All right, catch me up to speed here. What do we got?" "You're putting Cheeto fingers all over the wall." "Allright, Let's focus, Dee. What's the point of entry here?" "That's the thing, Charlie. I've been looking all around this goddamn place. I can't find one." "All right. I've seen this before. You know what happened? I bet it flattened itself out, went right through a seam in your wall." "I don't think there's anything in the laws of nature that would support that." "Cats do not abide by the laws of nature, all right? You don't know shit about..." Dennis: We're still gonna watch the movie, right?" Charlie "Uh-Uh, yeah." "Yeah?" Dee: "I think its stuck in there." "No! It's not stuck. All right. Let's focus on what's happening with the cat, all right? It made a concious decision to go in your wall. Correct?" "Really?" "Absolutely. Absolutely. It chose to be in there. It wants to be in your wall, Dee." "Thinking about getting some catnip and I was gonna put it-" "No, no, no, no. Don't do that. Don't do that. It's gonna know that's a trap, Dee. Okay? That's gonna irritate the cat, then it's gonna dig itself down further. We may never get to it. Okay?" "You serious?" "Let's start thinking like a cat here. All right? You know, we- we need another cat. That's what we need. Here's what we're gonna do. I'm gonna crack a little hole in your wall- Tiny one. It'll be cool. And then I'm gonna slip a second cat in with a string tied around it. Those two will become codependent, then I'll rip the second cat out and the first one hopefully- hopefully will follow." (...) "All right. Where are we gonna get this other cat?" "I can get you another cat. I got followed here by, like, 10 cats. Yeah, they're starting to follow me these days." (...) E10 je geniální. DENNIS system. MAC system. "I wait till you're done with them. And then I swoop in, give them shoulder to cry on, and then we hump." "You been humping these girls after I'm done with them?" "Oh, yeah, dude. I come in as the sensitive intellectual type. Why do you think I'm always reading books and shit when we do the spider routine?" "I thought you were just my wing man though." "No. No. Im swimming in your wake." Frank: "What are you two dickheads doing here?" "What are you doing here?" "What do you mean, I'm here for the scraps." "I haven't had a chance to get in there yet, okay? So just-" "What's taking you so long?" "Wait, wait, wait! You have a system where you come in after Mac?" "That's right. I come in after Mac. But he's taking forever this time. I got my magnum condoms. I got my wad of hundreds. I'm ready to plow." "You should see him feast. He's like a mantis. It's amazing." "Oh, that's good. Call me that from now on. Mantis." (...) Shyamalan. Charlie: "He's like a true-to-life Slumdog Millionaire. You know what I mean?" "He always puts some awesome twists at the end of his movies to trick the audience." Charlie: "Oh, yeah, yeah, like in The Sixth Sense. You find out that the dude in that hairpiece the whole time- That's Bruce Willis- the whole movie." (...) (drunk Charlie and Max covered in paints, after almost getting into shower with hot sexy college girls, drinking beers at bar) "I mean, like, If  I had known college was anything like that, the amount of book learning I would have put to my brain-" "Read! And math, dude!" "-to get there and stay there." "They shower together!" "And naked."(20.10.2024)méněvíce
